1170-6747-8164.easyPrerequisites:
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
You control at least two artifacts.
1170-6747-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.
1170-6747-8164.notes: You could start with less artifacts as the Heartwoods will count towards the cost reduction. You need to provide additional mana to compensate.

4694-6258-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

560-2457-2757.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3457-5983-7791.description:
Activate Snapping Voidcraw by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Snapping Voidcraw.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Snapping Voidcraw.
Repeat.

215-1879-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1879-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-2351-6460-7730.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-7730.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2173-2469-4699-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

4149-4599-4871-6019-6633.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

877-7093-7647.notablePrerequisites:
You control two other nontoken, untapped colored legendary creatures.
You have a colored legendary creature card in hand.
Morophon has a type chosen that is found on all three of the legendary creatures mentioned above.
877-7093-7647.description:
Activate Supportive Parents by tapping two untapped colored legendary creatures, adding one mana of any color.
Cast any colored legendary creature for its web-slinging cost by paying {0} due to Morophon and returning one of the creatures tapped in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat step 2 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.
877-7093-7647.notes: The type chosen by Morophon can be any type so long as each of the three legendary creatures are the chosen type.

413-470-2661-7635.notablePrerequisites: The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
413-470-2661-7635.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G}.
Gwenna and Ascendant Packleader trigger.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ascendant Packleader trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghalta. When Ghalta enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ghalta.
Choose to return Ghalta to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4146-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic
1618-2440-4146-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4146-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

465-2292-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3372-5466-7193.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Omni-Changeling's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

3459-4311-5078-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

57-2751-4359-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4359-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

338-1939-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1939-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-3641-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-3641-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-2034-6972--112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
284-2034-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

549-856-2511-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-4518-4924-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

560-2457-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4772-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3464-3657-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-6478.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

222-527-3967-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

440-1339-2275-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2275-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3662-3942-4872.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
3662-3942-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Time Warp from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2837-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2837-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating either a 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

2-1270-2034-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

186-467-549-1978-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
186-467-549-1978-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

413-575-1207.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
413-575-1207.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When the Forest enters the battlefield as a creature due to Ambush Commander, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1799-2034-3781.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken Insect.
Grenzo has power equal to or greater than the Insect's base power.
1799-2034-3781.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
When the Insect dies, Zask's first ability triggers, causing you to put the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting the Insect into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1523-3018-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1523-3018-4050-4186.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters the battlefield, Eutropia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2404-4954.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine creatures.
2404-4954.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least nine {G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Gaea's Cradle to become a 8/8 Elemental with haste, and untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
